Title: Public Preview: Applications in Azure API Management

Body.Content:
Announcing the public preview of the Applications feature in Azure API Management. This new capability introduces a more streamlined and secure way to manage OAuth-based access to your APIs and products.  

 

With Applications, API publishers and developers can now more effectively manage client identity, access, and authorization flows.  

 

Key capabilities:  

  • The API Management gateway can authorize access to products and APIs using OAuth tokens  
  • API managers can identify which products require OAuth authorization  
  • API managers can create and manage client applications and assign them access to specific products  
  • Developers can view their registered applications and use OAuth tokens to securely call APIs and products  

 

This feature simplifies identity and access management in API programs, enabling a more secure and scalable approach to API consumption.  

Learn more.
